title: Y-12/Oak Ridge legacy program studying the skin of two recovered saucers

tellings.quote: he has stated he has worked under the Y12 complex which houses Oak Ridge on a UFO legacy program that studies the skin of two recovered uh non-human saucer craft.

plain: A man is said to have worked at the Y-12 complex at Oak Ridge, Tennessee, a government nuclear site, on a long-running secret UFO programme that studies the outer skin of two recovered saucers built by non-humans. The online researcher known as UAPGerb tells Michels this as what the man "has stated," without naming him, and also names the research contractors MITRE and Battelle. If true, it would mean pieces of non-human craft are being studied at a US nuclear facility.
